items.description: Diagnostic inspection of the cracked laptop
items.rationale: Battery report shows full-charge capacity 79% of design, below the 80% threshold; under 2.6.8 the unit is no longer portable insured equipment, no battery waiver agreed (standard form, no extras). 2.6.7 / 5.2.3 then deny the examination cost too.

items.description: Laptop screen and lower-right corner repair
items.rationale: Clause 2.6.8: battery at 79% (<80%) means end of working life, damage is not an insured event whatever the cause; 2.6.7 excludes repair. If it were covered, the quote of about EUR 549 would apply.
